_comment: Exact reference-scanner versions the 'pinned' benchmark mode verifies against. Update by re-checking each tool's latest published release and its exact source commit, then bump both fields together in the same PR that updates this file's own review — never just the version string alone. skil itself is intentionally absent: it is built directly from this repository's own source, so 'pinned' has no separate meaning for it. A tool's own top-level key (e.g. 'cisco-skill-scanner') is always the CURRENT pin the runner's --*-binary flag for that tool is checked against; a '-historical' sibling key (present only once a tool has had more than one pin) is never checked automatically — it exists so a past pin is never simply lost when the current one moves forward, and can still be installed and run manually for an explicit before/after comparison.

cisco-skill-scanner-historical._comment: Superseded by cisco-skill-scanner above on 2026-09-06 (2.0.14 -> 2.1.0). Kept for an explicit before/after comparison; not checked by verify_pin against any --*-binary flag.
